A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] occurred in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. This battle took part of the offensive planned by [[reborn]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to reconquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Those assaults were executed by the reunified [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] and loyal Imperial forces prior to the launch of [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. After the conquest of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] and the conquest of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] by [[Imperial Core|Imperial Deep Core forces]], the two fleets reunited to attack [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle makes its unique appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The battle is only illustrated on the galactic map of the conflict.
